### Average F

```{r}
plot_report(pop$F_bar, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = "Average F")
```

### F-at-age

```{r}
mu_F <- pop$mu_F
if (!is.null(mu_F)) {
  names(mu_F)[names(mu_F) == "est"] <- "mu"
  mu_F$mu[mu_F$mu == 1] <- NA
}
F <- if (is.null(mu_F)) transform(pop$F, mu = NA_real_) else
  merge(pop$F, mu_F, by = c("model", "year", "age", "is_proj"), all.x = TRUE)
plot_report(F, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "F") |>
  add_lines(y = ~mu, linetype = I(2), showlegend = FALSE, name = "mu", line = list(width = 0.5)) 
```

### Selectivity

```{r}
plot_report(pop$S, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", ylab = "Selectivity", frame = ~year,
           color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols)
```

### M-at-age

```{r}
mu_M <- pop$mu_M
if (!is.null(mu_M)) names(mu_M)[names(mu_M) == "est"] <- "mu"
M <- if (is.null(mu_M)) transform(pop$M, mu = NA_real_) else
  merge(pop$M, mu_M, by = c("model", "year", "age", "is_proj"), all.x = TRUE)
plot_report(M, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = "M") |>
```
